name: Cadalso (Spain)
description: Green field with a yellow pile issuing from the lower edge to a point at the top, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cadalso (a scaffold and a cross of Alcántara on green).
history: The arms and the flag of Cadalso were approved by the Order of 4 March 1998 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 21 March 1998, after the municipal council's approval on 4 July 1997.

features.role: pile from the lower corners to the middle of the upper edge
